description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of values associated with categories numbered 0 through 5. The chart contains five slices, each representing a different category. The largest slice, labeled “2”, is light green and represents 22.4% (6583) of the total. Next is a light blue slice labeled “0”, representing 13.3% (3910), followed by a pale yellow slice labeled “1” at 13.8% (4046). A light teal slice labeled “3” represents 6.8% (2002), and a light gray slice labeled “4” represents 6.2% (1810). Finally, a small slice labeled “5” is colored a slightly darker blue and represents 10.4% (3043). Percentage labels and corresponding numerical values are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and decreasing in size. A legend is not present in the chart.
